observations: Inspected the complete numbered composition and all eleven small-component sheets, covering 132 tiny regions. Most small regions are intentional bead-border interstices, eye highlights, necklace gaps and diamond-panel edge triangles, so retain them rather than filtering by size. Exclude only listed isolated acute endpoints. Reconnect inspected same-detail fragments in two top crown gaps, facial highlights/mouth slits, narrow hair outlines and one bead interstice. Multiple figures, stacked window faces, dome/block frame, diamond-pattern garment, throne bead borders, flame scroll and bottom scallops receive feature/position names. No historical subject is inferred from the filename. Source pixels, canonical ink and prior packages remain unchanged.
